title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
notes: UNVERIFIED DRAFT: audited against official sources, with unsupported draft checks withdrawn. Not approved for enforcement. Historical amendments and statutory exceptions remain incomplete. Legacy rule identifiers are retained for compatibility; use citation.clause for the actual clause. See docs/AUDIT.md.

rules.title: Name and complete address of the manufacturer, packer or importer

citation.text: Every package shall bear thereon a definite, plain and conspicuous declaration of the name and address of the manufacturer, or where the manufacturer is not the packer, of the packer, and for imported packages the name and address of the importer.

messages.passed: Manufacturer or packer identity and address are declared.
messages.violation: The package does not carry the name and complete address of the manufacturer, packer or importer. A brand name alone does not satisfy Rule 6(1)(a).
messages.inconclusive: A manufacturer declaration was located but the address could not be read with confidence.

rules.title: Common or generic name of the commodity

citation.text: Every package shall bear the common or generic name of the commodity contained in the package.

messages.passed: The common or generic name of the commodity is declared.
messages.violation: No common or generic name is declared, or the brand name has been used in its place. Rule 6(1)(b) requires a description of what the commodity actually is.

citation.text: Every package shall bear the net quantity, in terms of the standard unit of weight or measure, of the commodity contained in the package, or where the commodity is packed by number, the number of the commodity contained in it.

messages.passed: Net quantity is declared in a standard unit.
messages.violation: No net quantity declaration could be found on the package.

rules.title: Net quantity expressed in a correct standard unit symbol

citation.clause: Rule 6(1)(c) read with the Legal Metrology (General) Rules, 2011
citation.text: The net quantity shall be expressed in terms of the standard unit of weight or measure, using the unit symbol prescribed for that unit.

messages.passed: The net quantity uses a prescribed unit symbol.
messages.violation: The net quantity is expressed using a non-standard unit symbol. Prescribed symbols are case-sensitive, are not pluralised, and do not take a full stop.

rules.title: Month and year of manufacture, packing or import

citation.text: Every package shall bear the month and the year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported.

messages.passed: Month and year of manufacture or packing are declared.
messages.violation: The month and year of manufacture, packing or import are not declared. A 'best before' period alone does not satisfy Rule 6(1)(d).

citation.text: Every package shall bear the retail sale price of the package.

messages.passed: A retail sale price is declared.
messages.violation: No retail sale price is declared on the package.

rules.title: A single retail sale price per package

citation.clause: Rule 6(1)(e) read with section 36, Legal Metrology Act, 2009
citation.text: A package shall bear one retail sale price. Declaring more than one price for the same package, or altering the declared price, is a non-standard declaration.

messages.passed: A single retail sale price is declared.
messages.violation: More than one distinct retail sale price appears on this package. Dual pricing, or a revised price applied over the original, denies the consumer the benefit of the declared maximum.

rules.title: Retail sale price declared in the prescribed form

citation.text: The retail sale price shall be declared in the form 'Maximum Retail Price Rs. ... inclusive of all taxes', or in the form 'MRP Rs. ... incl. of all taxes'.

contains_phrase: inclusive of all taxes local or otherwise

messages.passed: The retail sale price is declared in the prescribed form, inclusive of all taxes.
messages.violation: The retail sale price is not declared in the prescribed form. The words 'inclusive of all taxes' are absent, so the declared price does not tell the consumer what they will actually pay.

citation.text: Every package shall bear the name, address, telephone number and email address, if available, of the person who can be or the office which can be contacted in case of consumer complaints.

messages.passed: Consumer care contact details are declared.
messages.violation: The package does not identify a person or office contactable for consumer complaints, with a telephone number or email address.

rules.title: Declared unit sale price is arithmetically correct

citation.text: The unit sale price shall correspond to the retail sale price of the package divided by the net quantity contained in it.

messages.passed: The declared unit sale price matches the price divided by net quantity, rounded to two decimal places.
messages.violation: The declared unit sale price does not follow from the declared price and net quantity. A unit price that understates the true rate defeats the comparison the declaration exists to enable.
messages.inconclusive: The unit-price arithmetic cannot be compared with sufficient confidence.

citation.text: Every package shall bear a declaration of the unit sale price, expressed per gram, kilogram, centimetre, metre, millilitre, litre or unit as applicable.

messages.passed: A unit sale price is declared.
messages.violation: No unit sale price is declared. This declaration has been mandatory since 1 January 2024 and is what allows a consumer to compare value across pack sizes.

rules.title: Country of origin for imported commodities

citation.text: Where a package contains an imported commodity, the package shall bear the name of the country of origin of the commodity.

messages.passed: Country of origin is declared for this imported commodity.
messages.violation: This package appears to contain an imported commodity but does not declare the country of origin.

rules.title: Mandatory declarations grouped together on one panel

citation.text: Panel screening only. The PDP may include pre-printed information in one place and on-line information in another; physical panel differences alone do not establish an offence.

messages.passed: The mandatory declarations are grouped on a single panel.
messages.violation: The mandatory declarations are scattered across different panels rather than grouped together at one place as Rule 7 requires.
messages.inconclusive: Panel assignment requires review: pre-printed and on-line declarations may occupy separate places.

rules.title: Minimum measured declaration height by panel area

citation.text: Screening of measured declaration heights against the PDP area table. Full legal applicability requires review.

messages.passed: The measured declarations meet the selected panel-area height threshold.
messages.violation: A measured declaration is smaller than the selected panel-area height threshold.
messages.inconclusive: Physical height or panel area is missing or too uncertain; re-capture with a scale reference.

rules.title: Minimum height of the net quantity numerals

citation.text: Screening of numeral height against the PDP area table; see the official Rule 7(2) text and applicable exceptions.

messages.passed: The net quantity numerals meet the minimum height for this panel size.
messages.violation: The numerals declaring net quantity are smaller than the minimum height prescribed for a principal display panel of this area.
messages.inconclusive: The measured numeral height cannot be distinguished from the prescribed minimum within the measurement uncertainty. Re-capture with a scale reference.

rules.title: WITHDRAWN: Declarations not to be affixed to the bottom of the package

citation.text: The cited Rule 9(2) concerns reading through liquid, not bottom placement.

messages.inconclusive: The cited Rule 9(2) concerns reading through liquid, not bottom placement.

rules.title: Net quantity in Hindi or English (script screening)

citation.text: The declarations required under these rules shall be made in Hindi in Devanagari script or in English, and nothing shall prevent the use of any other language in addition.

messages.passed: The net quantity uses Latin or Devanagari script; language and complete declaration coverage require review.
messages.violation: Neither supported declaration script was identified. Verify the original label.
messages.inconclusive: The declaration script could not be established.

rules.title: WITHDRAWN: Retail sale price rounded to the nearest rupee or fifty paise

citation.text: Rule 11 concerns declaration of quantity; this draft supplies no authority for a 50-paise price increment.

messages.inconclusive: Rule 11 concerns declaration of quantity; this draft supplies no authority for a 50-paise price increment.
